audience_question: Why does the committee provisionally recommend Station hall, and what is the alternative?
fit_rationale: Both venues are supplied on the same criteria, so a two-option comparison keeps capacity, hire, access, and constraints directly comparable while highlighting the stated capacity and bus access priority.
tradeoff: Station hall offers the stated capacity and bus access advantages; Garden room has a lower provisional evening hire and tools can stay in a locked cupboard.
caveats: All costs are provisional quotes for one evening; staffing and insurance are excluded.
